content.short: Butane Protocol is a Cardano synthetic-assets project focused on collateralized minting through a dedicated dApp.
content.description: Butane Protocol is building a synthetic-assets protocol for Cardano. The project describes its core flow as depositing collateral and minting synthetic assets through a dedicated dApp and protocol layer. Its positioning is straightforward: bring collateral-backed synthetic exposure to Cardano users through an on-chain product built specifically for that use case.
content.meta: Find out about Butane Protocol ($BTN) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
